name: 8ft Heavy-Duty Folding Table – Extra Large, Durable & Portable
descriptionHtml:
8ft Heavy-Duty Folding Table

Take your booth or event setup to the next level with our 8ft Heavy-Duty Folding Table, built for durability, stability, and convenience. Perfect for trade shows, food booths, catering, and outdoor events, this table provides extra space without compromising portability.

💪 Heavy-Duty Construction: Sturdy steel frame and reinforced high-density plastic tabletop designed to support heavy loads and withstand daily use.

📏 Extra-Large Surface: 8ft length offers generous workspace for product displays, food service, or multi-purpose setups.

⚙️ Folding Design: Easily folds in half for compact storage and transport.

🚚 Portable & Lightweight: Despite its size, the table is easy to move and set up anywhere.

🧽 Easy to Clean: Smooth, non-porous surface wipes clean quickly after use.

🎯 Versatile Applications: Ideal for trade shows, food booths, vendor markets, catering services, and outdoor events.

Product Dimensions:
Size: 96" L x 30" W x 29" H
Weight: Approx. 40 lbs

Materials:
Frame: Steel
Tabletop: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE)

Primary Usage:
Trade shows, food booths, vendor markets, catering, and outdoor events
